About the Company

Greetings from Teamware Solutions a division of Quantum Leap Consulting Pvt. Ltd

Teamware Solutions (a division of Quantum Leap Consulting Pvt. Ltd.) is a 20+ year industry leader providing IT staffing and consulting services, supporting 4000+ professionals across India, the USA, the Middle East, and APAC for leading GCC clients.

About the Role

We are hiring a Full Stack Data Engineer Python, React, Snowflake & Azure

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Noida, TrivandrumWork Model: HybridExperience: 6 to 9 yearsNotice Period: Immediate - 15 days

Data Engineering - Full Stack Engineer 

Experience: 8+ years | Function: Data Management & Engineering | Type: Full-time | Location: Hybrid

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for an AI-forward Full Stack Engineer who is comfortable working across the data lifecycle -from source ingestion and transformation through database design, APIs, and modern front-end experiences. The strongest candidates will bring experience working with investment-management data and understand how core data domains such as positions, transactions, pricing, market data, security master, reference data, account data, and related investment data fit together to support front-office use cases

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Approximately 6-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on experience across both backend/data engineering and front-end development.Experience using modern AI development tools such as Codex, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools, with an interest in incorporating AI meaningfully into day-to-day software development.Strong programming skills in Python, with experience building production-quality data pipelines, services, or applications.Experience developing modern web applications using React and JavaScript/TypeScript.Strong SQL skills and practical experience designing, querying, and optimizing relational or analytical database structures.Experience building data pipelines involving ingestion, transformation, validation, and delivery of large or complex datasets.Experience developing or consuming REST and/or GraphQL APIs.Working knowledge of cloud-based data environments and modern data warehouses.Experience with Azure, Snowflake, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is required.Strong understanding of the full data lifecycle: source -> ingestion -> transformation -> database curated datasets -> API / application / analytics consumption.Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data issues across multiple layers, including source data, transformations, databases, APIs, and user-facing applications.Experience working in asset management, investment management, capital markets, or similarly data-intensive financial environment.Familiarity with the core data concepts that underpin front-office investment workflows, including positions / holdings, transactions, pricing, market data, security master, reference data, account and portfolio data, and risk or analytics data.Ability to understand how these data domains relate to one another and how they are consumed by Portfolio Managers, Traders, Risk professionals, and investment analytics users.Comfortable working in a fast-paced engineering environment with shared ownership of production systems.Domain knowledge in front-office workflows, including risk, trading, and positions. Familiarity with accounting systems is mandatory

Nice-to-haves

Experience supporting Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk, or other front-office investmentworkflows directly.Experience with private markets, alternatives, or Private Equity data.Experience with Snowflake performance optimization and data modeling.Experience with near-real-time or event-driven financial data.Familiarity with Spark or other distributed data-processing frameworks.Experience developing semantic or analytics-ready datasets for tools such as Tableau, Power BI,Sigma, or Pyramid.Exposure to AI/LLM application development, including retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or natural-language interfaces over enterprise data.Java experience in addition to Python.

Senior Full Stack Data Engineer with strong Python + SQL + Snowflake + Azure/AKS, hands-on React/TypeScript and API development, strong data pipeline experience, and investment/asset-management domain knowledge including accounting and front-office workflows.

Please let me know if you are interested in this position and send me your resume to hidden_email .

0b37f5c2aa822cb0.description: ## **About Juniper Square** Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! *Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.* ## **About your role** As a Business Analyst on the Revenue Operations team, you will sit at the intersection of business and technology, translating operational friction into clear requirements and scalable solutions. You will partner with teams across RevOps, Marketing Ops, Engineering, Product, and GPX to identify AI and automation opportunities, define requirements, and drive implementation from discovery through post-launch. Should be comfortable working in US East Coast hours (7:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST) ## **What you’ll do** - Understand internal customers' needs and facilitate setting project goals and objectives — acting as a trusted advisor from discovery through launch - Conduct business discovery sessions with GTM and cross-functional stakeholders to surface pain points and identify automation and AI opportunities - Translate business requirements and process needs into actionable technical requirements, including comprehensive BRDs and user stories - Facilitate meetings for requirements gathering, refinement, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and enablement with GTM partners and cross-functional teams - Partner with GTM systems teams to drive alignment and track implementation through UAT and post-launch optimization across Salesforce, Outreach, and Gong - Conduct testing, track issues, and manage resolution throughout project lifecycles - Manage projects and report on status, setting expectations and timelines across concurrent workstreams - Map, document, and maintain current-state and future-state business processes; contribute to the RevOps Confluence document repository - Deliver user training and present on project launches to GTM and cross-functional partners - Leverage AI tools (Claude, Gemini, and similar) to improve throughput and analysis quality in your day-to-day work ## **Qualifications** - 2 to 3 years as a Business Analyst/ Business Systems Analyst in a closely related analytical role (requirements gathering, process mapping, stakeholder management, project management) - Demonstrated ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences; comfortable working with GTM systems teams and business leaders in the same conversation - Proficient in creating process flow maps and writing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) - AI fluency: concrete, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) with at least one specific example of business impact - Strong analytical skills, including the ability to query and interpret data - Strong Excel and Google Sheets capabilities, including data mapping, clean-up, audits, and QA - Project management experience: can set timelines, report on status, and communicate progress across concurrent workstreams - Preferred background in go-to-market functions such as sales, marketing, or revenue operations; experience in a tech or startup environment is a plus

Experience: 8-12 yearsLocation: Mumbai (on-site)Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (First Attempt)
About the Role:
A fast-growing consumer brands platform backed by leading investors is seeking an International Finance Controller to strengthen its global finance function. With a portfolio spanning beauty, wellness, nutrition, healthcare, and lifestyle categories, the company is scaling rapidly across India, the US, UK, and other international markets. This role offers high visibility with leadership and investors, and significant ownership in shaping the next phase of global growth.
Key Responsibilities:- Lead end-to-end financial accounting, reporting, and controllership across international entities.- Drive timely monthly, quarterly, and annual closures with consolidated reporting.- Strengthen governance frameworks, SOPs, and compliance mechanisms across domestic and overseas operations.- Ensure compliance with Ind AS, Companies Act, GST, TDS, Income Tax, FEMA, transfer pricing, and other regulatory requirements.- Manage statutory, internal, and tax audits, along with group-level finance reviews.- Oversee treasury operations, cash flow, working capital optimization, and fund utilization.- Partner with leadership on profitability, cost optimization, and strategic finance initiatives.- Lead finance process automation, ERP implementation, and reporting standardization.- Manage inter-company transactions, reconciliations, overseas remittances, and transfer pricing coordination.- Build strong relationships with banks, auditors, and external advisors.- Support corporate structuring, due diligence, investment evaluations, and strategic projects.
Ideal Candidate:
- Chartered Accountant (CA) with 8-12 years of experience.- Strong background in controllership, accounting, reporting, audits, treasury, and compliance.- Hands-on exposure to international finance operations, FEMA, transfer pricing, and cross-border transactions.- Experience in multi-brand, consumer-facing businesses with manufacturing and distribution.- Solid understanding of working capital management, governance frameworks, and process automation.- Prior exposure to global audits, international reporting, and M&A integration preferred.- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, entrepreneurial environment.
Why Join:
- Opportunity to build and scale the global finance function for a rapidly growing consumer brands platform.- Exposure to multiple high-growth brands across India and international markets.- High visibility with leadership, investors, and business teams.- Significant ownership and impact in shaping the company's global growth journey.
Note: The interested professionals with relevant experience should be currently in Mumbai.

0b2848580721916f.description: Job Description : Job Summary : We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills, experience with machine learning frameworks, and the ability to solve complex business problems using AI technologies. Key Responsibilities : - Design, develop, and implement AI and machine learning models. - Collect, clean, and preprocess large datasets. - Train, test, and optimize machine learning algorithms. - Deploy AI models into production environments. - Monitor model performance and improve accuracy over time. - Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders. - Research and implement the latest AI techniques and technologies. - Document AI models, workflows, and technical solutions. Required Skills & Qualifications : - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. - Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Java, or C++. - Experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn. - Knowledge of deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), or computer vision. - Understanding of software development practices, APIs, and version control (Git). - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications : - Experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). - Knowledge of prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases. - Experience deploying AI applications using Docker and Kubernetes. - AI or cloud certifications are a plus. .

0b09dccfb3716743.description: Job Title Procurement Business Analyst Job Description Procurement Business Analyst | Pune | Full-time The Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE) team at Vanderlande is a energetic group of professionals dedicated to providing strategic support and enhancing demand and supply management capabilities. Comprising diverse roles such as RfX Specialists, Contract Administration Specialists, Procurement Reporting Analysts, Procurement Cost Analysts, Procurement Market Insight Analysts, and Supplier Onboarding Specialists, the team collaborates closely with the demand and supply management teams to deliver high-quality support and insights. Operating across global and regional centers, our team thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence, making a significant impact on the organizations success. What you will do As a Global Procurement Business Analyst, you will support the global Procurement organization with recurring and ad-hoc reporting, analytics, dashboard development, and management insights across multiple procurement disciplines. You will work closely with procurement stakeholders to understand business challenges, translate reporting requirements into meaningful analytics, and deliver accurate, actionable, and timely insights. You will leverage data from procurement platforms, ERP systems, spend analytics tools, supplier management solutions, and reporting applications to support informed decision making across the Procurement function. You will also collaborate with the Supply Data & Analytics team and digital teams to help design scalable reporting solutions, improve data quality, and drive adoption of standardized procurement reporting across Vanderlande Responsibilities Act as the central reporting and analytics partner for the global Procurement organization. Support the CPO, Procurement Leadership Team, Global Category Managers, and other stakeholders with actionable insights and reporting. Develop and/or maintain dashboards .
